concepts.def: Amount of product; depends on conditions
Balance of rate, yield and cost

walkthroughs.body_html:
Steepest gradient = fastest rate.

Curve flattens when reactant runs out.

Total amount produced is the final y-value.

Exothermic: products lower than reactants. Endothermic: products higher.

Activation energy = peak height above reactants.

Catalyst lowers the peak but does not change enthalpy.

Always a compromise between rate, yield and cost.

Higher temperature: faster but lower yield (if exothermic forward).

Catalyst: cheaper - higher rate without high temperature.
